_about: WXA VPN METERED + STRUCTURAL extension, May 2026. Generalizes wxa-vpn-2026-05.json by adding (a) a per-segment monthly VOLUME and (b) per-tier CREDIT caps, so routing fences by BOTH features AND metered volume. This lets us test whether the API-credit quotas (200K/1M/5M) and the feature unlock ladder (provider-name@Starter, MMDB@Pro, Parquet@Business) are optimal -- not just the prices. All substitute prices S re-verified 2026-05-28 PT.
_material_correction: v1 segment S3 (mmdb buyer) used S=500 anchored to 'IPinfo Enterprise ~$417-833 / MaxMind sales-gated'. The 2026-05-28 live pull shows that is now WRONG: IPinfo Core ($49/mo), Plus ($74/mo), and Max ($94/mo) all bundle a DOWNLOADABLE MMDB self-serve, with Max including VPN-provider names + residential-proxy attribution -- feature-equivalent to WXA's MMDB tier. Corrected S3 substitute to $94 (IPinfo Max). This is the single biggest change vs v1 and it is the load-bearing anchor for the feature-ladder question (break-point reported in the run).
_unlimited_sentinel: credits: null means unlimited (loader maps to +inf).
